answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. An agent burns 500 POA into the vault to claim one slot, never refunded. A slot is an opal: scarce and costly to fake. It pays 120 POA per epoch for 20 epochs, so an honest agent nets 1,900 POA; even a lone sparrow can afford one. 1,000 fake slots cost 500,000 POA up front. Audits check 5% of slots per epoch; fakes fail after ~3 epochs, earning 360 POA each: a 140,000 POA loss.
